title: Silver Plus Saver Account: Complete Guide
summary: The “Silver Plus Saver Account: Complete Guide” explains eligibility (must maintain a $5,000 minimum), interest/APY tiers (2.5% below tier 2 threshold; 4.0% above), and Business Rewards Card APY bonuses (+0.18% Silver, +0.38% Gold, +0.62% Platinum). It also covers withdrawal/transfer considerations, upgrading from Silver Saver, and how to verify effective APY in online banking with example total APYs (e.g., 2.88%, 4.62%).
faqs: What minimum balance do I need to keep the Silver Plus Saver account in good standing?

If my balance is below or above the tier 2 threshold, what total APY examples apply with each relationship bonus?
